old_behavior: inclusion = max(2, top*0.5); for an open-plan polygon with one item per section (top=1) the floor of 2 cleared NO section -> multi-label empty -> fell through to single max() -> 'Kitchen' (Dining dropped).
new_behavior: inclusion = min(top, max(2, top*0.5)); the noise floor is capped at the achievable max, so every equally-represented section qualifies. Identical to old for all top>=2; only the all-singleton case changes.
generic: No label/plan/floor_plan_id/furniture-id/coordinate special-case. Driven purely by contained-furniture section counts.
dining_validation_after: CONFIRMED via shared wall-proven 'Kitchen & Dining Area' polygon
